reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis assumes that pressure increases the density of states at the Fermi level, but in many BCC transition-metal alloys, compression broadens bands and can decrease the DOS; the link to robust superconductivity is speculative without electronic structure calculations.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a decisive falsification criterion (significant Tc decrease without DOS increase), though in-situ DOS measurement under high pressure is extremely challenging and not fully specified.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a relevant mechanism for pressure effects on superconductivity in HEAs and would guide a focused experimental study, though it lacks specificity on the alloy system and prior evidence.
